gaps.sentence: The match was called ___ because of the storm.
The car broke ___ on the motorway.
Who is going to deal ___ the angry customer?
gaps.explanation: deal with = handle; deal in = trade.

gaps.sentence: It's time you faced up ___ your responsibilities.
gaps.explanation: face up TO something = accept and deal with something difficult.

gaps.sentence: These old boots are completely worn ___.
gaps.explanation: wear out = become thin/unusable through use.

gaps.sentence: Please carry ___ with your work; don't mind me.
gaps.explanation: carry on = continue; carry out = perform (a task).

gaps.sentence: She cheered ___ when she heard the news.
gaps.explanation: cheer up = become happier (also transitive: cheer somebody up).
